headline: A custom AI receptionist that works with Shepherd.

howItWorks.body: Before booking, the agent checks provider availability through Shepherd's API. Shepherd provides an endpoint to retrieve available timeslots by provider and date range.
howItWorks.title: Checks availability in Shepherd

howItWorks.body: The agent can create a new appointment on the clinic calendar through Shepherd's API. It can also update an existing appointment. The agent only does what Shepherd's API allows and what you have approved it to do.
howItWorks.title: Books and updates appointments

howItWorks.body: Shepherd's API returns a paginated collection of appointments for the clinic. Prestique connects the agent to it so the agent works from the same information your team sees.
howItWorks.title: Works from the same appointment data your team sees

intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses. The agent answers calls when your team can't: after hours and when the line is busy.
You keep Shepherd. The agent works with it rather than replacing it. Where Shepherd offers an API, Prestique connects the agent to it so it can create records there, within what that API allows.
metaDescription: What a custom AI receptionist from Prestique can do with Shepherd, based on Shepherd's own published API documentation.
